title: Model Routing as a Cost-Reduction Primitive

questions.question: What happens when RouteSignals.hardSetSimilarity reaches the router's default 0.88 threshold?
options: The request is rejected as too difficult
The cheapest model is always selected
The request is pinned to the frontier model
The threshold is ignored until after a random retry
questions.explanation: The hard-set similarity short circuit selects frontier before normal candidate scoring.

questions.question: With outputTokens omitted, what output length does ModelRouter.estCost assume?
options: 50 tokens
100 tokens
150 tokens
200 tokens
questions.explanation: The method signature defaults outputTokens to 200 when callers provide only the prompt length.

questions.question: Which filters are applied before the weighted model score is calculated?
options: Required capabilities, context-window fit, and policy minQuality
Only the model's display name
Only output length and random seed
Provider error rate and GPU temperature
questions.explanation: candidates keeps models that cover every required capability, fit promptTokens in contextWindow, and meet policy.minQuality.

questions.question: What toy quality score does the cheap route receive for a hard Query?
questions.explanation: quality returns the difficulty map {simple: 0.99, medium: 0.92, hard: 0.75} for the cheap route.

questions.question: What does the CASCADE simulator do before deciding whether to escalate?
options: It calls the frontier model first and discards its answer
It sends every query to both models concurrently
It pays for the cheap model first, then escalates when confidence is insufficient
It routes all simple queries to the frontier model
questions.explanation: CASCADE always adds the cheap cost; simple queries or some medium queries stop there, while the rest pay an additional frontier call.

questions.question: Which catalog model is the only candidate that can satisfy a required vision capability?
options: haiku-class
sonnet-class
The router throws before inspecting capabilities
frontier
questions.explanation: The catalog gives vision only to frontier; haiku and sonnet have no vision capability in the local table.
